<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="blueGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1A73E9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#6C92F4"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="greenGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1DDE7D"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#72DFC5"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="170%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="10" stdDeviation="12" flood-color="#8385A3" flood-opacity=".18"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="softShadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="170%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#263238" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="24" y="27" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="320" y1="22" x2="320" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="325" y1="19" x2="325" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="16" x2="330" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="343" cy="22" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <line x1="346" y1="25" x2="350" y2="29" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <rect x="358" y="16" width="25" height="13" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <rect x="361" y="19" width="18" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="384" y="20" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- brand header -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="42" cy="76" r="16" fill="#066798"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="76" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="76" r="3" fill="#1DDE7D"/>
    <text x="66" y="82" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Circle Share</text>
  </g>
  <text x="350" y="81" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#7E8494">Passer</text>

  <!-- illustration shadow and frame -->
  <rect x="31" y="116" width="328" height="310" rx="28" fill="#D6D9DD" opacity=".25"/>
  <rect x="27" y="111" width="328" height="310" rx="28" fill="#E8EFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>

  <!-- window -->
  <rect x="55" y="137" width="133" height="108" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D3D7E0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="63" y="145" width="117" height="92" rx="4" fill="#C9E8F5"/>
  <line x1="121" y1="145" x2="121" y2="237" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="63" y1="191" x2="180" y2="191" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="4"/>
  <circle cx="160" cy="159" r="10" fill="#FFBE21"/>
  <polygon points="68,228 94,199 111,217 132,188 178,228" fill="#80B996"/>
  <polygon points="68,228 94,207 108,220 132,198 178,228" fill="#66A986"/>

  <!-- wall shelf -->
  <rect x="219" y="145" width="82" height="7" rx="3" fill="#A15842"/>
  <rect x="235" y="119" width="9" height="27" rx="3" fill="#E5CAA6"/>
  <circle cx="239" cy="116" r="11" fill="#FFB7D5"/>
  <rect x="269" y="127" width="20" height="18" rx="3" fill="#F9D8AC"/>
  <line x1="274" y1="132" x2="284" y2="132" stroke="#A15842" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="274" y1="137" x2="284" y2="137" stroke="#A15842" stroke-width="2"/>

  <rect x="293" y="205" width="26" height="35" rx="5" fill="#CA7358"/>
  <ellipse cx="306" cy="205" rx="29" ry="9" fill="#66A986"/>
  <ellipse cx="291" cy="189" rx="10" ry="22" fill="#80B996" transform="rotate(-31 291 189)"/>
  <ellipse cx="310" cy="180" rx="10" ry="26" fill="#66A986" transform="rotate(24 310 180)"/>
  <ellipse cx="322" cy="196" rx="9" ry="19" fill="#80B996" transform="rotate(42 322 196)"/>
  <line x1="306" y1="205" x2="306" y2="174" stroke="#A15842" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- desk -->
  <rect x="66" y="296" width="251" height="16" rx="7" fill="#A15842"/>
  <rect x="83" y="312" width="10" height="73" rx="4" fill="#A15842"/>
  <rect x="290" y="312" width="10" height="73" rx="4" fill="#A15842"/>
  <line x1="58" y1="385" x2="111" y2="385" stroke="#A15842" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="272" y1="385" x2="324" y2="385" stroke="#A15842" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- laptop -->
  <rect x="142" y="239" width="92" height="57" rx="6" fill="#24262B"/>
  <rect x="149" y="246" width="78" height="42" rx="3" fill="url(#blueGradient)"/>

  <polygon points="128,298 250,298 263,304 116,304" fill="#D3D7E0"/>

  <line x1="278" y1="276" x2="278" y2="264" stroke="#A15842" stroke-width="3"/>
  <line x1="269" y1="280" x2="261" y2="272" stroke="#A15842" stroke-width="3"/>

  <circle cx="252" cy="237" r="21" fill="#FDBCA0"/>
  <polygon points="231,233 235,211 258,204 274,221 269,233 259,222 247,228" fill="#30242A"/>
  <ellipse cx="250" cy="278" rx="38" ry="31" fill="#6893FD"/>
  <rect x="222" y="267" width="55" height="28" rx="13" fill="#6893FD"/>

  <circle cx="260" cy="237" r="2.5" fill="#30242A"/>
  <line x1="247" y1="248" x2="257" y2="248" stroke="#A15842" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="228" y1="279" x2="214" y2="297" stroke="#FDBCA0" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <circle cx="53" cy="270" r="7" fill="#1DDE7D"/>

  <polygon points="46,340 52,352 65,354 55,363 57,376 46,370 35,376 37,363 27,354 40,352" fill="#FFBE21"/>

  <!-- content -->
  <text x="195" y="472" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Partagez plus,</text>
  <text x="195" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="700" fill="#066798">vivez mieux.</text>
  <text x="195" y="548" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5F5F">Créez votre cercle et échangez</text>
  <text x="195" y="574" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5F5F">des objets, des services et des idées.</text>

  <!-- pagination -->
  <circle cx="169" cy="620" r="5" fill="#066798"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="620" r="5" fill="#D3D7E0"/>
  <circle cx="221" cy="620" r="5" fill="#D3D7E0"/>

  <!-- primary action -->
  <g>
    <rect x="45" y="670" width="300" height="56" rx="12" fill="#066798" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
    <text x="195" y="705" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Suivant</text>
  </g>

  <!-- lower reassurance -->
  <circle cx="111" cy="765" r="8" fill="url(#greenGradient)"/>
  <polyline points="107,765 110,768 116,761" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="126" y="770" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#7E8494">Une communauté proche de vous</text>

  <!-- home indicator -->
  <rect x="146" y="823" width="98" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
</svg>
